messages:
noah: midsummer dusk thread  looking for a movie score + guilty-pleasure singalong combo for rooftop listening tonight. low-key, nostalgic, slightly embarrassing. recs? 
emma: Movie score: "Only Lovers Left Alive" score (Jf3hann) for the dusk vibe. Guilty singalong: "I Want It That Way" by Backstreet Boys. perfect 2000s hum. :heart_eyes:
rafael: Movie score: "The Last Wave" type ambient surf/indie guitar (think: Sufjan-lite) + guilty singalong: 90s Eurodance banger. you know the ones. :dancer:
zoe: Score rec: "Paris, Texas" (Ry Cooder) for long-gaze sunsets. Singalong: cheesy karaoke classic "Living on a Prayer" 3b5.
chris: Mix idea: indie film score on loop while people whisper-sing along to guilty pop in the breaks. also bring glow sticks? :sparkles:
noah: vote quick with emoji: 
  \ud83c\udf3f = Only Lovers + Backstreet Boys
  \ud83c\udf0a = Surfy indie score + Eurodance
  \ud83c\udf43 = Paris, Texas + Bon Jovi

rooftop-bot: auto-playlist created: https://open.spotify.fake/midsummer-dusk (curated 90min mix)
emma: \ud83c\udf3f from me. the contrast is the point. also GIF of someone crooning badly during a sax solo.
rafael: \ud83c\udf0a. eurodance is underrated at sunset.
zoe: \ud83c\udf43 from me. theatrical belt.
chris: tally: 1,1,1. tie! tiebreaker: pick a single track that must be on the rooftop set.
emma: "Song of the Stars" (Jf3hann) for the score slot.
rafael: "Rhythm of the Night" (90s remix) for the singalong.
zoe: "Livin' on a Prayer" power chorus only.
noah: ok plan: rotate all three every 20 minutes. meetup at 20:15 on rooftop, bring one embarrassing karaoke line to teach the group. tiny speaker at the east railing. :microphone: 
chris: i will bring gummy bears and a disposable speaker. also a small printed sign that says "no judgement".
rooftop-bot: event reminder posted for rooftop listening 20:15 (auto-message).
